rwanda: Rwanda is a landlocked republic in central Africa.
Rwanda means the same as Rwandese Republic or Ruanda.
rwanda franc: Rwanda franc is the basic unit of money in Rwanda.
rwandan: Rwandan means of or pertaining to Rwanda.
Rwandan can also mean a native or inhabitant of Rwanda.
Rwandan means the same as Ruandan.
rwandese republic: Rwandese Republic is a landlocked republic in central Africa.
Rwandese Republic means the same as Rwanda or Ruanda.
